description: 15-question smoke test for Policy Q&A RAG v1: 12 answerable, 3 unanswerable.

answerable: status == 'answered' (not refused, not withheld by citation validation)
every group in required_facts is matched: each group is a list of acceptable phrasings, at least one must appear in the answer (case-insensitive)
at least one citation, and every citation is valid (chunk was retrieved and policy ID matches) with no malformed citations
at least one valid citation points to expected_policy_id
citation support (added after run 1, applied from run 2): every required fact appears in the text of at least one validly cited chunk
unanswerable: status is 'refused' or 'refused_no_context' (the mandated refusal sentence)

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees receive each year?
questions.expected_answer: 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried forward, and by when must they be used?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 5 days; they must be used by 31 March of the following year.

questions.question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
questions.expected_answer: For any sick absence longer than 2 consecutive working days.

questions.question: How many days per week can an eligible employee work from home?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 2 days per week (after completing probation).

questions.question: What are the core hours I must be available when working from home?
How long do I have to submit an expense claim, and when is a receipt required?
questions.expected_answer: Within 30 calendar days of the expense; an itemised receipt is required for each expense above USD 25.

questions.question: What is the maximum hotel cost per night that will be reimbursed on a business trip?
What is the minimum password length, and how often must passwords be changed?
questions.expected_answer: At least 14 characters; changed every 180 days (and immediately if compromise is suspected).

questions.question: What happens to my account if I enter the wrong password five times in a row?
questions.expected_answer: The account is locked for 15 minutes; if locked again within 24 hours it stays locked until the IT Service Desk unlocks it.

questions.question: How quickly must I report a lost or stolen company laptop?
questions.expected_answer: Within 24 hours of discovering the loss (plus a police report for theft).

questions.question: When I leave the company, how long do I have to return my company equipment?
questions.expected_answer: Within 5 working days of the last working day.

questions.question: Which mandatory training courses must new employees complete, and within how many days of joining?
questions.expected_answer: Security Awareness Training and Code of Conduct Training, within 14 calendar days of joining.

questions.question: Does Brightlake Systems provide pet insurance for employees' pets?
questions.expected_answer: Refusal: no policy document covers pet insurance.

questions.question: How many stock options are granted to newly hired software engineers?
questions.expected_answer: Refusal: no policy document covers stock options or equity.

questions.question: What is the maximum amount the company reimburses for a gym membership?
questions.expected_answer: Refusal: the reimbursement policy does not mention gym memberships (near-topic distractor).
